name: explorer-entities
goal: A person reviews the app as Pages, Components, Functions, Configs and Services: each entity shows its contract, size, performance and the evidence that proves it, with binary verification and no source unless Details Source is opened.

evidence: Spec specification/features/planned/explorer-entities.md lists 15 measurable gates from the 25 approved layouts and 4 policy files; public API (ExplorerContent props, EntityPlace, EntityLens, EntityVerdict) published in work/opus-approved-designs/entities-status.md before implementation. Proof: SSR component tests and pure helper tests written red against generated scaffolds, then green; isolated fixture screenshots at desktop/tablet/mobile.

21 components (ExplorerContent entry + Explorer*/Entity*), 7 presentation helpers (utils/entity*.ts) and 5 stylesheets under .ex-content implement the 25 approved layouts over the host lens {href, relations, evidence, behavior, history}; no file owned by data or shell was edited. svelte-check: 1623 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Harness audit of packages/reports passed. 33 unit manifests registered with declared responsibilities; 33 of 33 reasons recorded with harness explain add.

RED: helper tests 36 failed of 40 against generated scaffolds; after steering 11 failed; 6 SSR component files 32 failed of 32 and the browser spec 9 failed of 9 against the generated entry scaffold in an isolated copy. Logs and before/after screenshots in work/opus-approved-designs/entities-evidence. Component and browser tests were written after the components; only helper tests were written first.
